title: Quick Cataract Test
summary: Hazy details, close visual traps and important cataract warning signs in one quick challenge.

landing.intro: Cataracts can be easy to miss at first. See if you can spot the subtle clues across 10 quick questions - the final ones catch most people out.

about.body:
This ten-question challenge combines five on-screen visual puzzles with five general-awareness questions about cataracts. It measures answers to this quiz, not eyesight, lens health or the likelihood of a cataract.

Screen size, brightness, contrast, eyesight, corrective lenses, fatigue and device settings can all affect performance. Persistent blurry or hazy vision, glare, halos around lights, difficulty seeing at night or tones that seem less vivid should be discussed with a qualified eye-care professional.

steps: Complete five detail, pattern and visual-memory challenges.
Answer five questions about cataracts and when to seek help.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a visual-acuity test, eye examination, medical screening tool or diagnosis. It cannot confirm or rule out a cataract or any other eye condition. Seek urgent professional advice for sudden vision loss, severe eye pain or a sudden major change in vision.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your cataract challenge score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Crystal-Clear Standout
profile-1.copy: You caught almost every visual trap and understood the key cataract facts. This is an excellent quiz score, not a medical finding.

profile-2.title: The Focused Observer
profile-2.copy: You cleared the challenge with sharp attention and strong awareness. One carefully hidden clue may have prevented perfection.

profile-3.title: The Detail Spotter
profile-3.copy: You handled several close visual comparisons and important warning-sign questions well. A screen quiz cannot measure lens or eye health.

profile-4.title: A Hazy Round
profile-4.copy: The close matches and short memory sequence made this challenging. Display settings and many everyday factors can change performance.

profile-5.title: The Visual Traps Won
profile-5.copy: Several small differences slipped through this time. This result cannot indicate a cataract or replace a professional eye assessment.

score.disclaimer: This entertainment score cannot diagnose or rule out a cataract. Seek qualified eye-care advice for persistent or worsening changes.
